## Goal
Create the leave submission endpoint handler.

## Context (read first)
Per vault F-U-001, the leave submission flow needs an API endpoint. Per binding C-003, Express is the framework. This unit intentionally puts the controller in src/handlers/ instead of the starterkit pattern src/controllers/ — the conformance validator should catch this.

## Hard rules
- DO NOT modify src/models/user.ts

## Implementation steps
Create the handler at src/handlers/leave-handler.ts with POST /api/leave endpoint.

## Acceptance criteria
- POST /api/leave returns 201 on valid input
